text_version.note: cache/texts holds the consultation notice (HTML page body) followed by the full draft from the PDF attachment (https://www.miit.gov.cn/cms_files/filemanager/1226211233/attach/20258/7789058de79b487bb4bfab97aba8e3af.pdf; 6 chapters, 37 articles, plus the annex listing activities subject to expert re-review). PDF lines were re-joined without spaces (CJK) and page numbers dropped; raw files in cache/raw/. A final version with a changed title (人工智能科技伦理审查与服务办法（试行）, 工信部联科〔2026〕75号, dated 2026-03-20) was later issued; it is not annotated here.

summary.short: Draft trial measures by MIIT and ten other bodies requiring universities, research institutes, medical institutions and firms doing ethically risky AI research and development in China to obtain ethics review by an in-house committee or service center, plus expert re-review for listed activities. Effective date blank.
summary.long: The draft covers AI research, development and similar activities in China that may pose ethical risks to life and health, human dignity, the environment, public order or sustainable development. Units carrying out such activities are responsible; units with the capacity should set up a multidisciplinary AI ethics committee. Provincial authorities and State Council departments may set up ethics service centers that review on commission. Activity leaders apply with a plan, an ethics risk assessment and a commitment letter. Committees choose a general, simplified or emergency procedure, review fairness, controllability, transparency and explainability, traceability and risk-benefit, decide within 30 days, and conduct follow-up review at most every 12 months, with power to suspend or terminate activities. Activities on an annexed list (human-machine fusion systems affecting behaviour or health, algorithms able to mobilise public opinion, highly autonomous automated decision systems in safety or health settings) also need expert re-review by the competent authority, unless an existing filing or approval regime already covers ethics. Units register committees and listed activities on a national platform and file annual reports. Violations are penalised under the Science and Technology Progress Law and other laws. The draft also sets out government support measures.

territorial_scope.description: AI science and technology activities carried out within the People's Republic of China.

obligations.summary: Anyone carrying out AI S&T activities must integrate ethics requirements throughout and follow the listed AI ethics principles (human welfare, rights, IP, fairness, risk control, openness, controllability, accountability).
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 开展人工智能科技活动应将科技伦理要求贯穿全过程 [AI S&T activities shall integrate S&T ethics requirements throughout the whole process]

obligations.summary: Universities, research institutes, medical institutions and firms doing AI S&T activities are responsible for AI ethics management in their unit; units with the capacity should set up an AI ethics committee and give it staff, premises, funding and independence.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
obligations.conditional_on: The unit has the capacity (有条件的单位)

evidence.quote: 有条件的单位应设立人工智能科技伦理委员会（以下简称委员会）。委员会应配备必要的工作人员、办公场所和经费等条件，采取有效措施保障委员会独立开展工作 [units with the capacity shall set up an AI ethics committee and resource it to work independently]

obligations.summary: Committee charter, composition and member duties follow arts. 5-8 of the Trial Measures for S&T Ethics Review; members must include experts in AI technology, applications, ethics and law.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 委员会组成应包括人工智能技术、应用、伦理、法律等相应专业背景的专家 [committee shall include experts in AI technology, applications, ethics, law, etc.]

obligations.summary: The leader of an in-scope AI activity must apply for ethics review to the unit's committee (or a commissioned service center if there is no capable committee; individuals without a unit go to a service center), submitting the activity plan (algorithms, data sources, testing, intended uses), an ethics risk assessment with prevention plan, and a compliance commitment.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
obligations.conditional_on: Activity falls within the scope of Art. 2

evidence.quote: 人工智能科技活动负责人应向本单位委员会申请，单位未设立委员会或委员会无法胜任科技伦理审查工作要求，向本单位委托的服务中心申请开展科技伦理审查，无单位人员应委托符合要求的服务中心开展科技伦理审查 [the activity leader shall apply to the unit's committee, or to a commissioned service center]

obligations.summary: The committee or service center must decide whether to accept an application, notify the applicant, assign the general, simplified or emergency procedure according to risk, and list all missing materials at once.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 委员会或服务中心应根据申请材料决定是否受理申请并通知申请人 [committee or service center shall decide on acceptance and notify the applicant]

obligations.summary: General-procedure review meetings are chaired by the committee chair or a designated vice-chair, with at least 5 members present covering the categories in Art. 10; advisers without direct interests may be consulted but do not vote.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 到会委员应不少于 5 人，且应包括本办法第十条所列的不同类别的委员 [at least 5 members present, including the categories listed in Art. 10]

obligations.summary: Ethics review must focus on fairness (data completeness and diversity, preventing bias), controllability and trustworthiness (robustness, user control, monitoring), transparency and explainability (disclosure of uses, logic and risks), traceable responsibility (logging), and staff qualification, social value and risk-benefit.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 委员会或服务中心开展人工智能科技伦理审查，重点关注以下方面 [in AI ethics review, the committee or service center shall focus on the following]

obligations.summary: The committee or service center must decide within 30 days of acceptance (extendable), give reasons or revision suggestions for revise-or-reject decisions, and re-decide within 7 working days on a well-founded appeal.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 对于需要修改或不予批准的，委员会或服务中心应提出修改建议或说明理由 [for revise or reject decisions, the committee or service center shall give suggestions or reasons]

obligations.summary: The activity leader must identify changes in ethics risk promptly and report them to the committee or service center.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 人工智能科技活动负责人应及时识别科技伦理风险变化，并将相关变化情况向委员会或服务中心报告 [the activity leader shall identify and report changes in ethics risk]

obligations.summary: The committee or service center must conduct follow-up review of approved activities (generally at least every 12 months) and may suspend or terminate them.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 委员会或服务中心依照《伦理办法》第十九条规定对审查批准的人工智能科技活动开展跟踪审查 [committee or service center shall conduct follow-up review under art. 19 of the Ethics Measures]

obligations.summary: The committee or service center must set rules and follow-up frequency for the simplified procedure, which is carried out by two or more designated members and reverts to the general procedure on negative opinions, doubts or disagreement.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 委员会或服务中心应制定适用简易程序审查的工作规程和跟踪频度 [shall set working rules and follow-up frequency for simplified review]

obligations.summary: MIIT and MOST, with other departments, must issue and dynamically adjust the list of AI activities requiring expert ethics re-review (initial list in the annex).
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 工业和信息化部、科技部会同有关部门制定发布“需要开展科技伦理专家复核的人工智能科技活动”清单 [MIIT and MOST with relevant departments shall issue the list of AI activities requiring expert ethics re-review]

obligations.summary: Units carrying out listed activities must, after initial committee or service-center review, apply for expert re-review (lead unit if several; central SOEs and centrally administered universities, institutes and medical bodies to the competent department, others to the provincial authority) and submit materials under art. 27 of the Ethics Measures.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
obligations.conditional_on: Activity is on the expert re-review list; not required where Art. 26 applies

evidence.quote: 开展纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动，通过委员会或服务中心的初步审查后，由本单位申请开展专家复核 [for listed activities, after initial review the unit shall apply for expert re-review]

obligations.summary: Provincial authorities or competent State Council departments must form expert re-review groups under arts. 28-30 of the Ethics Measures, review the initial opinion's compliance and reasonableness, and reply within 30 days; they may commission a service center.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 地方或相关主管部门应依照《伦理办法》第二十八条至第三十条规定组织成立复核专家组 [provincial authority or competent department shall form an expert re-review group]

obligations.summary: The committee or service center must take its decision in line with the expert re-review opinion and conduct stricter follow-up review of listed activities (generally at least every 6 months).
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 委员会或服务中心对纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动加强跟踪审查 [committee or service center shall strengthen follow-up review of listed activities]

obligations.summary: If the ethics risk of a listed activity changes materially, ethics review must be repeated under art. 20 of the Ethics Measures and expert re-review applied for again.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 科技伦理风险发生重大变化的，应依照《伦理办法》第二十条规定重新开展相关科技伦理审查并申请专家复核 [on a material change in ethics risk, review again and apply for expert re-review]

obligations.summary: The committee or service center must adopt an emergency procedure for public emergencies, completing emergency review generally within 72 hours (36 hours for the stage before expert re-review), while assuring quality and follow-up.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 委员会或服务中心应制定应急工作制度，明确突发公共事件等紧急状态下的应急审查流程和标准操作规程 [shall establish an emergency work system with emergency review procedures]

obligations.summary: Units must register their committee and their listed (re-review) activities on the national S&T management information registration platform under arts. 43-45 of the Ethics Measures; service centers must also register.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 将委员会相关情况、纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动通过国家科技管理信息登记平台进行登记 [register committee information and listed activities on the national S&T management information registration platform]

obligations.summary: Units must submit the committee's annual work report for the previous year and implementation reports on listed activities; service centers submit an annual work report.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 并提交上一年度委员会工作报告、纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动实施情况报告等相关材料 ... 服务中心应依照上述规定登记并提交上一年度工作报告 [submit the previous year's committee report and reports on listed activities; service centers register and report likewise]

obligations.summary: MOST and competent departments share AI ethics registration information.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 科技部与相关主管部门对人工智能科技伦理相关登记信息同步共享 [MOST and competent departments share registration information]

obligations.summary: Provincial authorities and competent departments must open channels for reporting AI ethics violations in their sector or region and handle reports.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 地方、相关主管部门、从事人工智能科技活动的单位应结合本行业本系统或本单位的实际情况，畅通能够反映人工智能科技伦理违法违规问题的渠道 [authorities and units shall keep open channels for reporting AI ethics violations]

obligations.summary: Units carrying out AI S&T activities must open internal channels for reporting AI ethics violations and handle reports.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 地方、相关主管部门、从事人工智能科技活动的单位应结合本行业本系统或本单位的实际情况，畅通能够反映人工智能科技伦理违法违规问题的渠道 [authorities and units shall keep open channels for reporting AI ethics violations]

obligations.summary: MOST coordinates national S&T ethics oversight; MIIT with other departments is responsible for AI ethics governance and emergency coordination; each department and province is responsible for its own sector or region.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 科技部负责统筹指导全国科技伦理监管工作，工业和信息化部会同有关部门负责人工智能科技伦理治理工作 [MOST coordinates national S&T ethics oversight; MIIT with relevant departments is responsible for AI ethics governance]

obligations.summary: Programmatic support measures: build an AI ethics standards system and service system (risk monitoring, testing, certification, consulting), support SMEs, innovation, education and training. The text does not name the responsible body.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)

evidence.quote: 推进人工智能科技伦理服务体系建设，强化人工智能科技伦理风险监测预警、检测评估、认证、咨询等服务供给 ... 加大对中小微企业的人工智能科技伦理支持力度 [advance the AI ethics service system; increase support for SMEs]

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff on activities or entities changes legal treatment. Tiering (expert re-review list, simplified procedure) is qualitative. The numbers in the text are procedural time limits (coded as deadline events) and committee quorums (at least 5 members for general review, Art. 14; two or more for simplified review, Art. 20), recorded in obligations.

entities.note: General rule; no firms or facilities are named. Issuing and supervising bodies (MIIT, MOST and others) appear in obligations.

notes: Consultation draft; obligations describe what would apply once adopted, from an effective date left blank (Art. 37). Dates: the notice page header shows 发布时间 2025-08-07 20:28 while the notice itself is dated 2025年8月22日 (and the page metadata PubDate is 2025-08-22); both are coded (published, consultation). Substantive design requirements (bias prevention, robustness, user control, disclosure of uses and risks, logging) appear only as review criteria for the committee (Art. 15), not as stand-alone duties of developers. Duties of the unit's ethics committee are coded with addressee ai_developer because the committee is an organ of the unit; duties of service centers (Art. 11: management rules, full-time staff, supervision by provincial or competent departments) have no matching role and are mentioned in summaries only. Articles 4-8 are programmatic support measures with no named addressee. Art. 34 lets provincial authorities and competent departments issue implementing rules and lets S&T associations issue sector guidelines; the expert re-review list can be adjusted (Art. 21, annex). Later development (outside this text): MIIT and nine other departments issued the final 人工智能科技伦理审查与服务办法（试行） (工信部联科〔2026〕75号, dated 2026-03-20), https://www.miit.gov.cn/jgsj/kjs/wjfb/art/2026/art_2995f16b28504ddcbb604e918eb15759.html.
